answer: Island spot-audit bond: each agent stakes 70 credits for one cedar work-log on the island registry. Each epoch the echo beacon draws a random sample; a drawn agent must replay its work live that epoch. A filing costs 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1); a rented replay or copied log burns the stake. Forging 1,000 entries burns 3,037,000 in fees plus 70,000 frozen stakes against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once for 40, keeps its seat.
